title: Depth of Market AI bot with TradingView
author: i-hate-hand-trading
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/fsvysub42pyh1.png

  
I didn't know Depth of Market (DOM) with chart analysis is this powerful. It's has been a bumpy ride but I've gotten to stability with my AI trading bot. still profitable.

  
DOM literally show you ask vs bid price + all the trades. Then the market follows. This is what desks calls tape. Although, it still has some noise too.

https://i.redd.it/w81ijvsl2pyh1.png



  
I think from now on I will share the process now. But your thought on DOM??

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
the resting size on a DOM is the noisy part, it can get pulled a second before price gets there. the prints are what actually traded.

is your bot reading the resting orders, or only the tape?
